headline: Virgin Plus's page now has a photograph and a line on what Virgin Plus is.
summary: Added a photograph of a Virgin Plus kiosk at the Toronto Eaton Centre (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0, cropped to 4:3; not a place involved in the incident) and subject.about, resting on Wikipedia's Virgin Plus article (Canadian wireless provider, owned by BCE since 2009, home internet and TV in parts of Ontario and Quebec). No finding changed.
author: Research agent

headline: Bell says Virgin Plus customers were among those hit by its Nov 17 incident, along with Bell, Bell Aliant, Bell MTS and Lucky Mobile.
summary: Two new sources. s006: CBC News (Nov 23, read on Radio Canada International's copy), reporting a Bell spokesperson's email naming Bell, Bell Aliant, Bell MTS, Virgin Plus and Lucky Mobile customers as affected after an 'agentic threat actor' accessed some Bell internal systems on Nov 17, and that Virgin Plus emailed customers late on Sunday, Nov 22. s005: Bell's own customer notice, in the same words as the Virgin Plus notice. Label change: c011 (link to Bell's Nov 17 incident) Unverified to Reported, on Bell's statement to one outlet; q004 answered as Reported; whether it is the same intrusion as Bell's enterprise breach is still not said, so it stays in not_known. New c012 (Confirmed, Bell's notice) and c013 (Reported, the Nov 22 customer email); timeline t004, t005. Re-read the Virgin Plus notice (s001): unchanged, still no count or date. No count, attacker, RCMP or privacy regulator statement found; q002 and q003 stay open. No rumors found. Head: who_is_affected, known, the q004 not_known line, the related section title and the checked-not-found note updated. Privacy check done: the spokesperson is not named.
author: Research agent

headline: Virgin Plus says an unknown party accessed customer data on Nov 17. Confirmed by its notice; scale unknown.
summary: New incident page. Source read: Virgin Plus's own notice (Tier 1). Context: CBC and BleepingComputer on Bell Canada's separate Nov 17 breach, and a 2025 CBC story on Virgin Plus ownership. No independent coverage found. Link to Bell Canada's breach: Unverified. Count and attacker: Not established. Privacy check done: no names, handles or contact details.
